title: OpenTelemetry against Google Cloud, and portability of instrumentation

videos.script: Instrumenting a service is slow work. You do not want to do it twice. {{twice}} OpenTelemetry is a standard for traces, metrics and logs. Your code calls its API, and never names a vendor. {{standard}} Between the code and the destination sits the Collector. It receives, it processes, it exports. The credentials live there, not in every service. {{collector}} This time the spans are real. You will trace one checkout on your own computer, and read the four spans the Collector received. {{real}} Then you will point the Collector at Google, by changing one file. The code does not move. {{google}} What does not move with it: dashboards, alerts and SLOs. Those stay with the vendor. {{limits}}
